# Shadeop Per-thread Init and Procedures Module Requirements Quality Checklist: Versioned Plug-in ABIs (spec 037)

**Purpose**: Are load/unload lifetimes, per-thread state and the single-loader modules completely and unambiguously specified?
**Created**: 2026-10-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts/ read for cross-checks)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Shadeop module and per-thread init

- [x] CHK001 Is "shading thread" defined (renderer thread index vs OS thread; what `thread` the init receives)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK002 Is the lifetime of per-thread data stated in the spec (research Q2: until `RiEnd`) rather than only "before the module can be unloaded"? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, §US4-1]
- [x] CHK003 Is it stated that per-thread init may run concurrently on different threads, and that cleanup may run on a different thread than init? [Gap, Spec §FR-011; contracts/shadeop.md §1]
- [x] CHK004 Are per-thread init failure semantics defined (NULL data: valid state or error)? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK005 Is behaviour defined when the number of threads changes between frames or when an operand is first used mid-frame? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK006 Is the unload point of shadeop modules (session end) stated as a requirement, and is the compiler's load-then-unload scan lifetime stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK007 Is operand selection order defined when several modules define the same prototype (scan order, directory enumeration order, determinism between renderer and compiler)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013, §US4-4]
- [x] CHK008 Is the optional per-thread entry-point table's relation to the 1.0 table (parallel array, one version per module) clear in requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §Edge Cases "many tables"]
- [x] CHK009 Is SC-007's "N distinct data pointers" reconcilable with "init once for each thread that executes the operand" when fewer than N threads execute it? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-007, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK010 Is a legacy shadeop's "exactly as today" behaviour defined for init arguments (`init(0, NULL)`) and concurrency documentation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §US4-2]
- [x] CHK011 Is the parser's accepted grammar (characterization against the old `dsoParse`, unknown characters, no length limit) a stated requirement, not only a contract test? [Gap, Spec §FR-012, §FR-037]
- [x] CHK012 Is "no file-static shared state" for the parser measurable (reentrancy test, single definer)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-037, §US4-3]

## Procedures module

- [x] CHK013 Does FR-022 ("the RI entry point calling it") agree with the Assumption and US5-4 that the Scene Interface must not depend on Procedures directly (contract uses a hook)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-022, §US5-4, §Assumptions "Domains"]
- [x] CHK014 Is a module's reference-count/lifetime rule stated for all three kinds, including implicit/DLO instances still alive at process exit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Are generators expanded from `ObjectBegin` definitions or across several frames covered by FR-024's "released at frame end"? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK016 Is raytrace-hider teardown (hierarchy freed regardless of refcount) reconciled with the "held until geometry destroyed" rule in the requirement text? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK017 Is the generator name resolution (unchanged: loaded exactly as written, no search path) stated, given FR-023 changes DLO to load the located path? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, §FR-023; research Q4]
- [x] CHK018 Do version outcomes for DynamicLoad (optional symbol, no warning when absent, rejected MAJOR when present) appear in the success criteria for the "each family" SC-001/SC-002? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §SC-001, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK019 Are error texts "naming the module as today" specified for missing entry point / failed init in all three kinds? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK020 Are thread-safety requirements for concurrent acquisition of the same module stated (the "one version check per module" claim under races)? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases "loaded twice"]
- [x] CHK021 Is SC-008's `osLoadModule` count criterion explicit about which files are permitted (procedures, shadeop, display host) and whether bindings/tools count? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008]
